ui.tutorial.dungeon: Send a villager into the dungeon
ui.tutorial.p1.place_home: Every great factory begins with a Primitive Home. This is where your villagers will be born.
ui.tutorial.p1.exit_gate: Villagers need a way out! Place an exit gate so they can leave the Primitive Home.
ui.tutorial.p1.initial_path: Now draw a path from the exit so villagers have somewhere to walk.
ui.tutorial.p1.place_forestry: Your villager needs a job! Place a Forestry gathering spot on a forest tile.
ui.tutorial.p1.forestry_entrance: Villagers need a way in! Place an entrance gate on the Forestry so they can enter.
ui.tutorial.p1.connect_to_forestry: Connect the path from the Primitive Home exit to the Forestry entrance.
ui.tutorial.p1.watch_gathering: Your villager will spawn, walk along the path, and enter the Forestry. With bare hands, he can only pick up sticks!
ui.tutorial.p1.place_stockpile: The villager is carrying sticks but has nowhere to drop them off. Place a Stockpile!
ui.tutorial.p1.select_sticks_filter: Open the Stockpile Inspector and use the Product Picker to select 'sticks' so only sticks are stored here.
ui.tutorial.p1.stockpile_entrance: Place an entrance gate on the Stockpile so villagers carrying items can enter and drop them off.
ui.tutorial.p1.forestry_exit: The villager needs a way out of the Forestry! Place an exit gate so he can leave after gathering.
ui.tutorial.p1.connect_to_stockpile: Draw a path from the Forestry exit to the Stockpile entrance so villagers can deliver their sticks.
ui.tutorial.p1.watch_dropoff: Watch the villager leave the Forestry carrying sticks and drop them off at the Stockpile.
ui.tutorial.p1.stockpile_exit: The villager dropped off his sticks but is stuck in the Stockpile. Place an exit gate so he can leave!
ui.tutorial.p1.loop_path: Draw a loop path from the Stockpile exit back toward the Forestry entrance. This creates a repeating production loop!
ui.tutorial.p1.place_inn: Workers get exhausted! Place a Resting Spot (Inn) so your villager can recover stamina.
ui.tutorial.p1.watch_full_loop: Watch the full production loop in action: gather sticks, drop off at Stockpile, rest at the Inn, repeat!
ui.tutorial.p1.complete: Phase 1 Complete! Your production loop is fully operational!

tut.01.celebration: Objective complete! Your spawner is ready!
tut.01.step.0: Place a Spawner by clicking the Spawner icon on the hotbar, then click on a tile on the map.
tut.02.hint: Place a PathGate exit on your spawner so villagers can leave.
tut.02.celebration: Exits let villagers leave a building onto the path. Entrances let them enter. The puzzle is getting the routing right!
tut.02.step.0: Select the PathGate tool from the hotbar. Place it adjacent to the spawner, facing away from it. That makes it an Exit — villagers leave the building onto the path.
tut.02.complete.0: Exit placed! Villagers will now leave the spawner and walk the path.
tut.03.hint: Now draw a path from the exit so villagers have somewhere to walk.
tut.03.step.0: Select the Path tool from the hotbar, then draw a short path from the PathGate exit.
tut.04.hint: Watch your first villager spawn and walk along the path.
tut.04.step.0: Watch — your first villager spawns from the spawner, exits via the PathGate, and walks along the path!
tut.05.hint: The villager reaches the end and has nowhere to go. Place a Forestry gathering spot on a forest tile!
tut.05.celebration: Great! Your lumber mill is set up!
tut.05.step.0: The villager has nowhere to go! Place a Forestry gathering spot on a forest biome tile.
tut.05.step.1: Place a PathGate facing toward the Forestry building to create an Entrance. Villagers will turn off the path and enter.
tut.05.step.2: Now draw a path connecting the exit to the entrance.
tut.05.complete.2: Path connected! Villagers will now enter the Forestry spot.
tut.06.hint: The villager has bare hands, so he can only pick up sticks. Watch him gather!
tut.06.celebration: He's gathering sticks! With no tool, bare hands can only collect sticks.
tut.06.step.0: Watch the villager gather. With bare hands he can only pick up sticks. An axe would let him collect logs!
tut.07.hint: The villager is getting tired. He needs an Inn to rest!
tut.07.celebration: The Inn is ready! Now your villagers can rest and recover.
tut.07.step.0: The villager is getting exhausted! Place an Inn nearby.
tut.07.step.1: Place a PathGate facing toward the Inn to create an Entrance. Villagers walking past will turn in to rest.
tut.07.step.2: Place a PathGate facing away from the Inn to create an Exit. Rested villagers will leave and continue on the path.
tut.07.step.3: Watch the villager enter the Inn to rest. Make sure the exit path doesn't loop back to the entrance!
tut.08.hint: You've set up sticks production, but you'll also need some stones.
tut.08.step.0: Place a Mining Structure on a mountain tile to gather stones.
tut.08.step.1: Use a Balancer or Splitter to route some villagers to the mine and others to forestry. Not everyone can work on forestry!
tut.09.hint: Now build a Craft Station to combine raw materials into tools and equipment.
tut.09.celebration: Your Craft Station is producing! Villagers drop off sticks and stones to make a Stone Hatchet.
tut.09.step.0: Place a Craft Station. Villagers with sticks and stones can walk to it and drop off materials to craft a Stone Hatchet.
tut.09.step.1: A villager carrying sticks must walk past the Craft Station input to drop them off. But first he has to drop his sticks — the Inn won't accept him with items!
tut.09.step.2: The Craft Station now has sticks and stones. Watch it produce a Stone Hatchet!
tut.10.hint: Build a Training Building and train your villagers into warriors, clerics, or other classes.
tut.10.celebration: Your villager has a class! Warriors, Clerics, Mages, Rogues — each has unique abilities.
tut.10.step.0: Place a Training Building. Select which class to train (Warrior, Cleric, etc.) and send villagers through it.
tut.10.step.1: An untrained villager will walk by and enter the Training Building to learn a class.
tut.11.hint: A trained villager with a weapon and armor can enter a dungeon. But be warned — about 90% don't make it!
tut.11.celebration: Dungeon entered! Survivors become Level 2 villagers and unlock tier 2 progression.
tut.11.step.0: Place a Dungeon Portal. A trained, equipped villager who walks to it will enter the dungeon.
tut.11.step.1: Send a trained, equipped villager to the Dungeon Portal. It's lemmings-esque — very few survive, but survivors level up!
tut.12.hint: Place a Stockpile to store resources. Villagers can drop off items here for later use.
tut.12.celebration: Stockpile ready! Your production chain has a buffer now.
tut.12.step.0: Place a Stockpile or Warehouse. Villagers can drop off their resources here.
tut.12.complete.0: Stockpile placed! You've completed the tutorial basics.

ui.tutorial.p2.place_second_spawner: Place a second spawner to grow your workforce!
ui.tutorial.p2.place_filter_splitter: Place a Filter Splitter to route villagers by their cargo.
ui.tutorial.p2.configure_filter: Configure the Filter Splitter to route stick-carrying villagers.
ui.tutorial.p2.connect_filter_craft: Draw paths from the filter output to the Craft Station entrance.
ui.tutorial.p2.watch_spear_craft: Watch the Craft Station turn 4 sticks into a Wooden Spear!
ui.tutorial.p2.place_warrior_trainer: Place a Warrior School to train villagers for combat.
ui.tutorial.p2.trainer_gates_paths: Connect the Warrior School with gates and paths.
ui.tutorial.p2.watch_training: Watch a villager train to become a Warrior!
ui.tutorial.p2.place_dungeon: Place a Dungeon Portal and connect it. The adventure awaits!
ui.tutorial.p2.first_dungeon_run: Send a Warrior into the dungeon. Most won’t survive — but those who do become legends!
ui.tutorial.p2.complete: Phase 2 Complete! You’ve built a full adventurer pipeline: gather, craft, train, conquer!
